'''Steve McFadden II Odds Beating Ewoks''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Steve McFadden II]]
* '''Published:''' September 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor: Dense Forest]]
* '''Strategy:''' Odds Beating Ewoks
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Odds Beating Ewoks II LS 1999.txt |Download]]
